blind.description: An ornate antique Victorian-style sofa featuring a carved wood/bronze frame, a curved crest rail, rolled armrests, and multiple carved legs. It is upholstered in deep red velvet with tufted/cushioned three-panel backing and long seat cushion, accompanied by two tan cylindrical bolster pillows resting at each armrest. The geometry is smooth, continuous, and well-detailed with no floating elements or structural defects.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it displays a roughly rectangular footprint with the ornate carved backrest along the top edge, the deep red seat cushion in the center, and two golden-tan bolster pillows on the left and right sides against the padded armrests.
blind.height_vs_figure: The sofa is about half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 2.5 to 3 ft tall) and slightly wider/longer than the figure is tall (approximately 5.5 to 6 ft long).
